bio: Diners come here for the atmosphere and tastes of Spain, especially Asturias, where the family who own the place hail from. On the menu, you'll find top-notch ingredients, succulent Iberian recipes – Iberian pork pluma, paella bodega (chicken, chorizo, cuttlefish, mussels and prawns), salt cod with aïoli, delicious turrón for dessert – as well as some daily specials. You won't be disappointed!...
